name: Automaton Flow Check
summary: Checks whether an issue really went through review, tests, CI, proof and production.
description: Reads GitHub and reports pass, warn or fail per issue for the review, tests, CI, proof and production checks.

application.description: Checks whether an issue really went through review, tests, CI, proof and production.
